defect: The change calls __KernelReSchedule inside the loop over chan.waitingThreads; a reschedule can run pending events that re-enter __AudioWakeThreads and modify the vector, invalidating the waitInfo reference and loop index.
reason: The fix moves the reschedule after the loop, replacing exactly the line this change added; seeing the re-entrancy needs knowledge of what __KernelReSchedule can run.

defect: The new early return in Core_Break for any state other than CORE_RUNNING_CPU turns the loaders' Core_Break('start-break') call during CORE_POWERUP into a no-op, breaking break-on-load.
reason: The fix, titled as a break-on-load regression fix, stops calling Core_Break from PSPLoaders.cpp because of this guard and corrects the guard's log typo; the affected callers are in another file.

defect: The added if (Memory::IsValidAddress(bufferPtr) in sceNetEtherNtostr is missing a closing parenthesis, so sceNet.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix only adds the missing parenthesis on the line this change added.

defect: The rewritten Clickable::Key clears down_ on every key event when the view is not focused, so the mouse-button KeyInput that SDL sends right after the touch-down resets the pressed state and clickables do not highlight.
reason: The fix exempts DEVICE_ID_MOUSE events from exactly this added check; that SDL emits a mouse key event after each touch-down is in base/PCMain.cpp.

defect: scePowerRegisterCallback indexes powerCbSlots[slot] with an unchecked guest value (slot -1 means auto-select, so it writes out of bounds), and scePowerUnregisterCallback neither bounds-checks slotId nor clears the slot.
reason: The fix adds auto-slot handling, range checks and slot clearing to the two functions this change added; the unchecked index is visible in the diff.

defect: Init now calls GetQueueFamilyProperties(GetGraphicsQueueFamilyIndex()), but Init runs from CreateDevice before ChooseQueue sets the graphics queue family, so it looks up queue family -1.
reason: The fix asserts the index and moves the profiler Init to ReinitSurface after the queue is chosen; the call order is in VulkanContext.cpp.

defect: __IoShutdown now calls pspFileSystem.UnmountAll(), which also removes mounts sceIo does not own (the disc and umd mounts made by the loader), so they are gone after an HLE reset that re-runs __IoInit.
reason: The fix, for a bug it says #14638 (this change's PR) introduced, replaces UnmountAll with unmounting only the devices __IoInit mounted; the other mount owners are in other files.

defect: MIM_DATA bytes are read from dwParam2 (the timestamp) instead of dwParam1, and the non-Windows stub branch lacks the includes it needs (midi_input.h, vector, string).
reason: The fix switches to dwParam1 and adds the includes, both in lines this new file introduced.

defect: UpdateUI now calls MainWindow::TranslateMenus on every UI update, from the emu thread and at least on start and stop, but TranslateMenus uses the current menu text as its key, so repeated calls re-translate translated text and append accelerators again.
reason: The fix keeps the original menu keys and posts the update to the UI thread; that UpdateUI runs repeatedly and how TranslateMenus works are in EmuThread.cpp and WndMainWindow.cpp.

defect: SetRenderFrameBuffer calls ReadFramebufferToMemory on the current render target whenever framebuffer state changes, reading unfinished framebuffers and leaving the FBO unbound (the read ends with fbo_unbind) when the same target stays current.
reason: The fix removes this call from SetRenderFrameBuffer and reads non-displayed framebuffers at the start of the next frame instead.

defect: The default argument round_to_zero = false is placed on the out-of-line VCVT definition in the .cpp instead of the header declaration, so callers in other files such as the four-argument call in ArmCompFPU.cpp do not compile.
reason: The fix moves the default to the declaration in ArmEmitter.h; a default argument on a .cpp definition is a visible mistake.

defect: The new R8G8B8A8 fallback writes (bAlpha) | 0xffffff00, putting the glyph alpha in the red byte and 0xFF in the alpha byte.
reason: The fix shifts alpha into the top byte, (bAlpha << 24) | 0x00ffffff, on the line this change added.

defect: The new D3D11 texture-color vertex shader computes mul(float4(Position, 1.0), WorldViewProj), copied from D3D9, which is the wrong order for the matrix as the D3D11 backend uploads it raw into a constant buffer.
reason: The fix flips the operands in this D3D11 shader that the change added; whether the order is wrong depends on the D3D11 uniform upload code in another file.

defect: The dynamic uniform buffer, created with D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, gets a ShaderResourceView (invalid for a constant buffer) instead of being bound as a constant buffer, so shaders never receive the uniforms.
reason: The fix deletes the SRV creation and member this change added and binds the buffer with VSSetConstantBuffers; the misuse is visible to a D3D11-aware reviewer.

defect: MemCheckAsm compares the base register xaddr_ against the breakpoint addresses and passes it to JitMemCheck without adding offset_, so memory breakpoints on reg+offset accesses miss or misfire.
reason: The fix subtracts offset_ in the compares and adds it before the call; that xaddr_ excludes the offset is set elsewhere in the file, outside the diff.

defect: Moving MainAudio onto a separate QThread crashes on Symbian.
reason: The fix restores unthreaded audio on Symbian, undoing exactly these added lines there; the platform crash cannot be seen from the code.

defect: HttpImageFileView starts a download whose callback is bound to this, but its destructor does not cancel the download, so a view destroyed mid-download has the callback run on a freed object.
reason: The fix cancels the download in the destructor and ignores cancelled callbacks in the class this change added.

defect: The added vai_.Clear() drops the map's raw VertexArrayInfoVulkan pointers without deleting them, leaking them on every device loss.
reason: The fix deletes each entry before Clear(); that vai_ holds owning raw pointers is declared in the header.

defect: Inside the new raw string literal the STR(CONST_PS_STENCILVALUE) concatenation becomes literal text, so the stencil pixel shader source is invalid HLSL.
reason: The fix closes and reopens the raw string around the macro on the line this change wrote.

defect: No defect in this change: the fix replaces p.Do(gpuStats) plus two ignored ints with a fixed GPUStatistics_v0 layout after later commits (e45c24b and others) added fields to GPUStatistics.
reason: At this change the current struct plus two ints matched the old savestate layout; old states broke only when later commits grew GPUStatistics, through the pre-existing p.Do(gpuStats).

defect: The new ins path with an immediate rs maps rt with gpr.MapReg(rt) and then modifies it without MAP_DIRTY, so the result is never written back.
reason: The fix adds MAP_DIRTY to exactly that added line; the other write paths in the same diff use MapDirtyIn.

defect: Streams are created with the channel counters before they are incremented, and the counters start at -1, so the first video and audio streams get channel -1.
reason: The fix pre-increments the counters in the lines this change edited.

defect: UnsyncKey computes retval from UnsyncKeyEvent but returns true unconditionally, so every key, including volume keys, is reported as consumed.
reason: The fix returns retval instead of true on the line this change added.

defect: The added printf(_t_, __VA_ARGS__) passes the log-type token as printf's format argument, which does not compile in debug builds.
reason: The fix drops _t_ from the printf this change added.

defect: The new pointer handlers pass the raw Windows PointerId as the touch id (assumed to start at 1) and call SetPointerCapture, but on Windows 10 Mobile the ids are arbitrary and capture is unusable, so touch input breaks there.
reason: The fix maps pointer ids to small touch indices and skips pointer capture on ARM in these handlers; the id assumption is in PPSSPP_UWPMain.cpp.

defect: vrnd_generate updates the E carry part with a guessed overflow formula evaluated after C and D are already updated, which does not match PSP hardware output.
reason: The fix computes E from the old C and D with a different formula that matches the test data; the mismatch is only visible against hardware results.

defect: The new check rejects lists with args->size >= 256 instead of checking args->numStacks, the stack depth the change meant to verify, so valid lists can fail with SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_INVALID_SIZE.
reason: The fix replaces size with numStacks in the check this change added; the mismatch with the stated stackDepth intent is visible in the diff.

defect: In the new WriteStoreOp the TYPE_REG/TYPE_IMMSREG case breaks only inside if (!SpecialOp), so register-offset LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH fall through to the default branch and emit BKPT.
reason: The fix moves the break out of the if; the fall-through is in the switch this change added.

defect: The new (addr & 3) check rejects misaligned relocation addresses as bad and skips them, but misaligned relocations are legitimate, so they are no longer applied.
reason: The fix removes the alignment check this change added; knowing such relocations are valid needs PSP ELF behaviour, not the code.

defect: Replay_Unload sets g_opToExec to Done and notifies opFinishWait, but the replay thread waits there on the predicate g_opDone, which stays false, so the following join() hangs.
reason: The fix replaces this mechanism with a g_cancelled flag checked in the wait predicate and the command loop; the predicate is visible in the diff's ExecuteOnMain.

defect: The new Spongebob special case passes GL_ADD, which is not a blend equation, to SetBlendAndMask instead of GL_FUNC_ADD.
reason: The fix replaces GL_ADD with GL_FUNC_ADD on the line this change added.

defect: The size-expression error message now passes exp, a PostfixExpression object, to sprintf's %s instead of the string str, which is undefined behaviour.
reason: The fix restores str on the line this change edited.

defect: On Symbian, executable memory now comes from a chunk heap (g_code_heap->Alloc), but FreeCodeSpace still releases it with FreeMemoryPages, which munmaps it and crashes on Return to Menu.
reason: The fix stops freeing JIT memory on Symbian and reuses the heap base; the mismatched free path is reached from ArmEmitter.h.

defect: The added NotEqualUnordered case computes fpcond as f[src1] != f[src2], but that mode is MIPS c.un, which is true only when an operand is NaN.
reason: The fix replaces this case with an either-unordered NaN test; the mapping of the mode to c.un is in IRCompFPU.cpp.

defect: The new branch in EmuScreen::touch drops every non-up touch event while bMouseControl is on, including real touchscreen input, not only mouse events.
reason: The fix limits the filter to events flagged TOUCH_MOUSE in the condition this change added.

defect: The new GetFilesList reads the file count from fileListAddr+12 instead of +0, which is wrong for games such as God Eater Burst and Gundam VS Gundam NP.
reason: The fix changes the offset in the function this change added; the correct field needs knowledge of the PSP structure, and the comment says both fields held 5 in the one tested game.

defect: DecodeRGBA4444 takes red from the top nibble and alpha from the bottom, reversing the PSP 4444 layout (red in bits 0-3) that RGBA8888To4444 in the same file uses.
reason: The fix reads r, g, b, a from nibbles 0, 4, 8 and 12 in the function this new file added.

defect: The rewritten delete-button condition tests the same button as the select condition before it, so delete can never trigger.
reason: The fix swaps CTRL_CIRCLE and CTRL_CROSS in the condition this change wrote.

defect: After destroying buffersWithAllocs_, PerformDeletes clears buffers_ instead of buffersWithAllocs_, so those VMA buffers are destroyed again on the next call.
reason: The fix changes the clear to buffersWithAllocs_ (and moves the list in Take); the copy-paste error is in the lines this change added.

defect: The new CLUT lookups mask the index with 0xE, dropping bit 0 and every bit above 3, so wrong palette entries are used.
reason: The fix changes the mask to 0xFF in both CLUT paths this change added.
